llmLogPlants._comment: P4.D283 (bug 196, v4 9ecebf986): two WARDROBE_ITEM_IMAGE rows on the image profile (the legacy variant has no profile columns), planted by BOTH sides on the llm-logs COPY before the data cases run, so the Almanack's per-image-profile roll-up counts wardrobe pictures as image spend. The committed .db pair is NOT rebuilt (a rebuild re-mints every id). The rows carry the builder's own request / response summary shapes (v4's LLMLogSchema validates every row `findByFilter` returns — a message without `contentLength` is dropped from the token total but not from the SQL aggregates).
